name: Sarzana (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sarzana (the letters OPQL above a star and a crescent on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Sarzana, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Sarzana arms — letters OPQL above a star and a crescent on blue, crowned, within branches
